title: Atlas 1.1 — Agent Registry
description: Roles and concrete session identities that act under PROTOCOL.md. An entry may be an abstract protocol role (e.g. CMOS) or a concrete instance of one (e.g. a specific executor session), linked via instance_of. Every capability an entry claims must exist in capability_registry.json.

instance_of.description: agent_id of the abstract PROTOCOL_ROLE this entry instantiates, if kind is SESSION_INSTANCE

capabilities.description: must each match an id in capability_registry.json

writes_registry.description: can this agent write canonical registry files directly, without going through a PR + founder merge

external_actions.description: can this agent take actions visible outside this repository (publish, email, pay, contract) on its own

verification_method.description: how this entry's existence/role was confirmed, e.g. 'PROTOCOL.md section reference', 'session self-declaration + founder acknowledgment'

source_ref.description: file or document defining this agent
